today.bonusUnlocked: One More, if you Want it

validation.packMissing: The {pack} model isn't on this device yet, so there's nothing here to check with.

week.title: Your Week
week.bestsBody: Measured only against your own weeks.
week.archiveNote: Recess keeps the last 12 weeks. Older ones fall away.
week.emptyBody: Resolve a nudge or two and this page will have something to say.
week.exitBody: That's the whole week. Nothing else loads.

onboarding.slide1Body: A few small things a day. Some take a minute, some take an afternoon.
onboarding.slide2Title: A Few a Day. Then you're Done.
onboarding.slide2Body: Four nudges, plus one more if you want it. There's no feed and nothing to catch up on.
onboarding.slide3Body: No account, no server, no one else. Everything you do stays on this device.
onboarding.interestsBody: Pick a few. This only shapes what comes up first.
onboarding.interestsNothingHidden: Nothing gets hidden. Every category still comes around.
onboarding.timesBody: Three quiet reminders a day. Change or silence them any time.
onboarding.timesDigest: Each one is a single summary of what's left, not a stream of alerts.
onboarding.notifDenied: Notifications are off, so the three digests won't arrive. Everything else works the same.
onboarding.modelsBody: Recess can check photos, writing, and audio on this device. The models download once, then work offline.
onboarding.modelsPrivate: Every check runs here. Nothing you write, say, or photograph is uploaded.
onboarding.modelsChecking: Checking what this device can handle
onboarding.packVisionBody: Checks a photo against what the nudge asked for.
onboarding.packTextBody: Reads what you wrote and scores it against the nudge.
onboarding.packAudioBody: Turns a short recording into words, then scores those.
onboarding.packWritingBody: Writes a line back about what you actually did.
onboarding.modelsFailed: That download didn't finish. You can try again in Settings.
onboarding.modelsSkipBody: Photo, writing, and audio nudges still work without them; you mark those done yourself. You can add them later in Settings.
onboarding.cellularWarn: You're on cellular data, and this download is not small.
onboarding.modelsSkipConfirmBody: Without them Recess can't check photos, writing, or audio, so you'll mark those nudges done yourself. You can download them later in Settings.

notifications.middayBody: {count} left, if you have a minute.
notifications.eveningBody: {count} left. Any one of them counts.
notifications.channelDailyDescription: A few calm reminders a day. Never content spam.
notifications.channelRemindersDescription: Reminders for nudges you started but haven't finished.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceDescription: Theme, font, text size, and motion.
settings.textSizePreview: Everything in Recess scales with this.
settings.animationsHint: Off means no transitions anywhere in the app.
settings.hapticsHint: A short buzz when a nudge resolves.
settings.soundsHint: Off by default. Recess is a quiet app.
settings.nudgesDescription: Categories, how many a day, and repeats.
settings.categoriesHint: At least one category stays on.
settings.categoriesFloor: At least one category has to stay on.
settings.interestsHint: Interests only shape what comes up first. Nothing is hidden.
settings.cooldownHint: How long a nudge waits before it can come back around.
settings.notificationsHint: Three calm digests at the times you set. No content, no streak warnings, nothing else.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications are turned off for Recess in your device settings. Turn them back on there and the three digests will start arriving again.
settings.notificationTimesHint: Each digest says how much of the day is left, and nothing else.
settings.eveningTimeHint: one last look before it closes
settings.modelsDescription: Validation packs and your device tier.
settings.tierHint: Larger models are more accurate and slower. The benchmark picks one; you can override it.
settings.packVisionHint: Checks a photo against what the nudge asked for.
settings.packWritingHint: Writes your weekly reflection and the lines after a nudge.
settings.packsHint: Packs run entirely on this device. Nothing you capture is uploaded.
settings.packStaleBody: Remove it and download again to match your current tier and language.
settings.cellularConfirm: This download can be large. Continue on cellular?
settings.exportHint: One JSON file with every nudge you've resolved.
settings.resetTodayHint: Clears today only. Earlier days stay.
settings.resetTodayConfirm: This clears the nudges you resolved today. Earlier days are untouched.
settings.wipeConfirm: This erases every nudge you've resolved, your points, and your Playground. It can't be undone.
settings.noBackup: There is no server and no backup. Export first if you want to keep any of it.
settings.replayOnboardingHint: Walks through the intro again. Nothing you've done is lost.
settings.aboutBody: No account, no server, no one else. Everything you do stays on this device.

permissions.cameraBody: This nudge asks for a photo. Recess only uses the camera when you tap to capture.
permissions.microphoneBody: This nudge asks for a short recording. Nothing is uploaded.
permissions.locationBody: This nudge checks roughly where you are. Your location never leaves the device.
permissions.notificationsBody: Turn notifications on to get your three daily nudges.

tour.deckBody: Swipe right to open a nudge, left to pass on it. A tap opens it too. Passing is not failing; it comes back around.
tour.ringTitle: Four a Day, Then you're Done
tour.ringBody: The ring fills as you resolve them. There is no feed and nothing to catch up on.
tour.listBody: Every nudge for today, in one list. Tap any line to jump straight to it.
tour.playgroundBody: Each nudge you finish plants one thing. Points scale the picture; they buy nothing.
tour.weekBody: A finite look back with your own numbers. Never anyone else's.
tour.replayHint: Walks through the deck and the tabs again.
